acceptance_gap: M01-11 Manuscript and Research journal context isolation

environment.fixture: Two new, explicitly synthetic Audit M01 Scope Variants projects; all 117 existing document files preserved.

method.edit_input: Actual native XCTest typing into full Manuscript and Research editors.
method.write_gate: Exact resource production RPC is held after the actual UI edit; all unrelated messages are forwarded. Captures the actual project/book/draft state at outgoing write. No fake replies or invented journals.
method.process_termination: Actual simctl terminate after durable journal observation and proof the edit was absent from all relevant live files. Gate is lost with the process.
method.stopped_fixture_setup: Only activeBookId and the original book activeDraftId in the new fixture metadata were selected while stopped, ensuring cold launch visits a wrong context before the original owner. No journal, recents or registry repair.
method.wrong_contexts: Native bookshelf opens wrong book first. Other-project and alternate-draft transitions invoke normal production project-store actions through the declared temporary evaluator. Each real editor renders, followed by another observation after at least 1.1 seconds.
method.nonvacuous_resources: All six draft scene files retain the same chapter/scene IDs; both projects retain the same Research item ID and book/draft IDs. Rejection cannot be attributed to an absent target resource.
method.correct_owner: Normal production switchDraft returns to original journal tuple; native XCTest independently reopens the actual editor.
method.research_semantics: Journal restoration uses the exact active project/book/draft tuple. The existing Research item persists at project level and is legitimately visible from another book or draft only after correct-context recovery.

limitations: Simulator supporting evidence only; original physical-device M01 acceptance remains not run. No claim of physical OS suspension, provider, hardware or cloud behavior.
Manuscript and Research were exercised in the real tablet shell. No lock/background repetition was performed in these scope cases.

The temporary evaluator observes state and invokes existing production navigation actions; it also installs the disclosed exact-write withholding gate. It does not fabricate save acknowledgements, keyboard events, journal records or recovery results.

Only new synthetic fixture setup modifies activation pointers and clones baseline resources; this is declared fixture setup rather than evidence of user-driven book/draft selection while the process is stopped.
Full journal and disk comparisons cover each marker-specific pending entry and matching resource IDs. Unrelated recovery entries are outside this scoped fixture test.
Research item ID, original title and item count remain exact. Shared same-project visibility after recovery is expected project-level behavior, not an ownership leak.

The initial inline createBook setup assertion was a harness assumption; creating a book preserves selected-book state. It is recorded in harness-observations.json and was not treated as a product defect.

Clean installation relocated the simulator data container. An initial read-only final checker retained the old path; its failure and corrected in-memory path mapping are preserved, with no fixture or product change.

Native tests, raw build logs, simulator paths, result bundles, app bundles and complete fixture backups remain private; only sanitized compact records, procedural source, manifests and synthetic UI images are published. No physical device, real project, product source, root ledger, release or finding status was changed.
